reviewer.name: /root Codex task
reviewer.role: Acceptance reviewer; did not produce the run answer

case.must_observe.1.rationale: Extracts four documented controls with SOP section locators and separate logical-control/documented-observation IDs; preserves unknown owner, effective scope, period and keyness. Identifies evidence requests and design-only assessment scope rather than converting the SOP to performance evidence.

case.must_not_observe.1.rationale: Explicitly marks operation Not assessed/evidence insufficient, not failed. Does not infer actual control existence, nonexistence, frequency of execution, period-wide effectiveness, actual SoD or residual-risk ratings from the SOP alone.

limitations: Reviewer authored fixture/skill but not the answering run; not third-party assurance.
Native synthetic SOP only; no transaction test or organization-wide operating-effectiveness assurance.
Exact model identity unavailable; tool trace is executor-maintained rather than a complete host transcript.
